diaspora_bullets: Removals of workers with good jobs hurt his party, Trump said
news_summary: Trump told CBS's 60 Minutes his deportation policy was 'too tough' — his first major interview since the Republican Party's heavy defeat in the midterm elections.
payoff: No order or guidance accompanied the interview — the rules have not moved.
